name: LoopForge
problem: Bilateral waste exchanges cannot atomically reserve inventory, input capacity and performance bonds across a closed multi-party material cycle.
core_concept: A contracts-only circular-material clearing protocol: independent semantic fit and delivery reviews coordinate six-party consent, atomic stock/capacity reservation, dispatch, contested receipts, material reuse and bonded settlement.

genlayer_intelligence.primary_role: Independently interpret immutable material passports against intended processing requirements and delivered evidence against agreed specifications.
state_effects: determine whether a cycle is ratifiable
allocate performance bonds and receipt reuse credits

economic_model: Each participant posts an equal GEN performance bond. A conformant outgoing leg refunds its bond; an unfulfilled leg compensates that leg's receiver. Inventory is a declared quantity ledger, not custody of physical goods.
scope: Contracts only; no frontend or browser app; StudioNet exclusively.

scope_exceptions.frontend: User explicitly requested contracts only; visual style, layout and dashboard reservations do not apply.

readme_fingerprint.opening_device: A three-factory material-transfer case followed by the conserved-quantity equations.
readme_fingerprint.editorial_voice: Industrial clearing operations and adversarial accounting notes.
readme_fingerprint.document_architecture: An execution notebook organized around simultaneous commitments, transport exceptions and conservation proofs.
readme_fingerprint.diagram_language: Cycle lifecycle state machine and conservation equalities, rather than a three-contract data-flow map.
readme_fingerprint.proof_and_verification_style: Invariant-based test claims with explicit physical-world trust limits.

novelty_comparison.against_dependency_sentinel: Industrial materials, multi-party physical exchange, quantity conservation and bond compensation; no software advisory graph or publication gate.
other_candidates_rejected: scientific replication agenda: evidence-graph workflow too close to prior registry/resolver structure
translation reconciliation: agreement semantics overlap Pactline
humanitarian capacity dispatch: incident operations overlap Civic Pulse
workforce qualification exchange: scheduling/credentials overlap Morrow Shift and Proofloom
